# Cases that do not match CPython jinja2, with the reason.
#
# This file is an admission, not a waiver. A case listed here that starts
# passing fails the conformance test, so the list can only shrink deliberately.
# Anything not listed must match exactly.

# --- CPython-internal wording -------------------------------------------------
# The exception class matches (RecursionError); only the message differs.
# CPython's text names where in the interpreter the limit was hit -- "while
# calling a Python object", "in comparison" -- which varies with the call
# shape and has no meaning in a Go library. gojja2 says which limit was
# exceeded and what it was set to instead.
minijinja/err_self_extends_txt.jj2       # RecursionError message is CPython-internal
minijinja/err_self_include_txt.jj2       # RecursionError message is CPython-internal
minijinja/err_self_macro_call_txt.jj2    # RecursionError message is CPython-internal
minijinja/loop-recursion-error_txt.jj2   # RecursionError message is CPython-internal

# --- lazy filters -------------------------------------------------------------
# jinja2's map/select/reject return generators, so printing one without |list
# renders "<generator object sync_do_map at 0x7f...>" -- an address that differs
# on every run, including between two runs of CPython itself. gojja2's sequence
# filters are eager and print the list. See docs/divergences.md.
minijinja/opfilters_txt.jj2              # jinja2 prints a generator's address
